papers.paperTitle: Question Paper Structure and Specific Instructions

topics: There are eight questions divided in two sections, out of which five are to be attempted.
Question No. 1 and 5 are compulsory. Out of the remaining questions, three are to be attempted choosing at least one question from each section.
The number of marks carried by a question/sub question is indicated against it.
Keep in mind the word limit indicated in the question if any.
Wherever option has been given, only the required number of responses in the serial order attempted shall be assessed.
Unless struck off, attempt of a question shall be counted even if attempted partly.
Excess responses shall not be assessed and shall be ignored.
Candidates are expected to answer all the sub-questions of a question together.
If sub-question of a question is attempted elsewhere, the later sub-question shall be overlooked.
Any page or portion of the page left blank in the Answer Booklet must be clearly struck off.
Unless otherwise mentioned, symbol and notation have their usual standard meanings.
Assume suitable data, if necessary and indicate the same clearly.
Neat sketches may be drawn, wherever required.
The medium of answer should be mentioned on the answer book as claimed in the application and printed on admission card.
Question No. 1: Solve any five out of seven short questions (40 Marks)
Question No. 2: Long and short questions (40 Marks)
Question No. 3: Long and short questions (40 Marks)
Question No. 4: Long and short questions (40 Marks)
Question No. 5: Solve any five out of seven short questions (40 Marks)
Question No. 6: Long and short questions (40 Marks)
Question No. 7: Long and short questions (40 Marks)
Question No. 8: Long and short questions (40 Marks)

importantNotes: Candidates will be allowed the use of Scientific (Non-programmable type) calculators wherever necessary.
Long question can be Derivative/Problem/Explain in detail diagram/sketch question.
Short question can be Definition/short notes justifying the marks assigned.
